name: Feature request
about: Suggest an enhancement to a version’s warehouse, scripts, or documentation
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem statement

Describe the problem or limitation you want to address.

## Proposed solution

Describe the script, object, or documentation change you would like.

## Alternatives considered

List any alternative approaches you considered.

## Scope

- [ ] Staging (`sql/staging/`)
- [ ] Warehouse dimensions, facts, or audit (`sql/warehouse/`)
- [ ] Load (`etl/`)
- [ ] Semantic views (`sql/semantic/`)
- [ ] Validation queries (`sql/validation/`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs/` or version README)
- [ ] New version folder

## Version folder

Which existing version should this apply to, or should it be a new version folder?

## Additional context

Examples, expected grain or measures, or related issues. Do not attach database backups or credentials.
